name: List All Community Association Rules
description: Returns Community Association (CA) rules that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter CA rules by last updated date. All GET requests must include a filter for [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the CA rule

responseFields.name: data[].AssociationId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the association related to the rule(s)

responseFields.name: data[].RuleName
responseFields.description: The name of the CA rule

responseFields.name: data[].RuleDescription
responseFields.description: A brief summary or description of the CA rule

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The last time a CA rule's details were updated by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
